title: Cheap query endpoint for cockpit polling
body: GSD-2's `gsd headless query` is ~50ms, no LLM, exit-code-driven status polling. Compose's cockpit currently polls vision-state and active-build via Express endpoints that touch the JSON store; fast enough for one tab, but not for many concurrent watchers (cron, CI, multiple cockpits). Add `compose query <feature-code> --json` with exit codes (0 ok, 10 blocked, 11 cancelled, 1 error) and a corresponding stripped-down REST endpoint that hits an in-memory cache only. Separates "show me state" from the heavier vision-state load path.
